rootCause.confirmedCause: P2b correctly advanced the library revision and removed the active V20 pointer without starting hotspot analysis. load_agent_immersive_background then called read_analysis_state as a hard prerequisite, so AGENT_IMMERSIVE_ACTIVE_SNAPSHOT_MISSING was raised before the WebGL canvas could mount.

contract.activeSnapshot: An explicit active V20 source must be ready, current for the library revision, and structurally intact. It is never silently replaced when present but invalid.
contract.historicalVisualSource: When no active pointer exists, startup may select the latest structurally intact ready snapshot only as historical visual data and must expose stale-by-library-revision metadata.
contract.analysisSemantics: A historical visual source is not the current hotspot-analysis result and is labeled in the UI with source/current revision and paper counts.
contract.importSemantics: Formal import still does not automatically start hotspot analysis.
contract.failureSemantics: Payload loading has a 15 second failure deadline and mounting has a 20 second failure deadline; either enters an explicit failed terminal state rather than waiting forever.
contract.startupReady: Only the first successful frame from the selected real dynamic WebGL renderer can release the splash. Static background remains an explicit diagnostic action only.

implementation.rustCore: select_immersive_background_visual_source validates active or historical V20 visual sources, aggregate counts, and orphan references with stable errors.
implementation.tauriPayload: load_agent_immersive_background returns visualSourceKind, analysisFreshness, stale reason, source/current revision, and source/current paper counts.
implementation.frontend: String rejections preserve Rust error codes; historical visual data is visibly labeled; payload and mounting deadlines terminate in failure; cold-start theory-not-ready may select the real immersive renderer before the first frame.
implementation.audit: sidera_dynamic_startup_r3_audit.mjs locks the no-static-fallback, explicit-terminal-state, metadata, and actual-first-frame contracts.
